column1: # POV Wheel Display - custom partition table (16MB flash)
# NOTE: ASCII only in this file. PlatformIO's own size check re-reads it with the
# system codepage (not UTF-8) and dies on anything else; the rationale in Russian
# lives in CLAUDE.md instead.
# app0/app1: 1024KB each. Firmware is ~650KB since Wi-Fi and the web UI were
#            removed (it was ~1120KB with them)
#            margin the old 1472KB slots left. Two slots are mandatory: BLE OTA
#            writes into the inactive one.
# littlefs:  14208KB (13.875 MB) - everything up to the reserved tail. That is
#            896KB more for the animation library than the old 13312KB layout.
# The last 64KB of flash (0xFF0000..0xFFFFFF) is NOT free: the firmware keeps
# the custom text and the effect settings there as raw flash (effects.cpp
# FXSTORE_*)
